title: 2014 YABANCI DİL BİLGİSİ SEVİYE TESPİT SINAVI (SONBAHAR DÖNEMİ) İNGİLİZCE

questions.questionText: 1. The story of creating power begins with the ---- of the most obvious natural resources around us - water and wind.
questions.explanation: Güç yaratma hikayesinin, etrafımızdaki en bariz doğal kaynaklar olan su ve rüzgarın 'kullanımı / sömürülmesi' (exploitation) ile başladığı belirtilmektedir.
options: A) termination
B) estimation
C) perception
D) exploitation
E) elaboration

questions.questionText: 2. Since a modern company cannot survive without information and computer technologies, they have become an ---- part of any commercial venture or worldwide business system.
questions.explanation: Modern bir şirketin bilgi ve bilgisayar teknolojileri olmadan hayatta kalamayacağı belirtildiği için, bunların ticari girişimlerin 'ayrılmaz' (inseparable) bir parçası haline geldiği ifade edilir.
options: A) unavailable
B) infrequent
C) intact
D) irrelevant
E) inseparable

questions.questionText: 3. Without knowing distances, it is difficult to ---- plan a journey, so maps are used by people to find their way easily.
questions.explanation: Mesafeleri bilmeden bir yolculuğu 'doğru / kesin bir şekilde' (accurately) planlamanın zor olduğu anlatılmaktadır.
options: A) accurately
B) suspiciously
C) innovatively
D) rapidly
E) controversially

questions.questionText: 4. Exposure to sunshine enables the production of vitamin D in our skin, and this ---- the growth and maintenance of healthy bones and teeth.
questions.explanation: Güneş ışığına maruz kalmanın derimizde D vitamini üretimini sağladığı ve bunun da sağlıklı kemiklerin ve dişlerin büyümesini 'teşvik ettiği / desteklediği' (promotes) belirtilmiştir.
options: A) deteriorates
B) declares
C) promotes
D) restricts
E) eliminates

questions.questionText: 5. Because children are so ---- to their environment, their cognitive development is greatly influenced by the amount of interaction they have with their parents.
questions.explanation: Çocukların çevrelerine karşı çok 'duyarlı / hassas' (sensitive) oldukları için bilişsel gelişimlerinin ebeveynleriyle olan etkileşimlerinden büyük ölçüde etkilendiği ifade edilmektedir.
options: A) sensitive
B) opposed
C) reluctant
D) resistant
E) accustomed

questions.questionText: 6. A stroke occurs when the blood supply of an area of brain cells is ---- for a long period of time, resulting in the death of the cells from lack of oxygen.
questions.explanation: İnme (felç), beyin hücrelerinin bir bölgesine giden kan akışının uzun bir süre 'kesilmesi' (cut off) durumu sonucunda meydana gelir.
options: A) set up
B) cut off
C) put down
D) left out
E) taken over

questions.questionText: 7. The famous artist Raphael's final works ---- so good that museums like the Prado and the Louvre ---- a whole exhibition to them.
questions.explanation: Raphael'in son eserlerinin 'çok iyi olduğu' (were) geçmişe ait bir gerçekliktir, müzelerin onlara sergi 'adamış olması' (have dedicated) ise geçmişten günümüze uzanan etkileri anlatan Present Perfect gerektirir.
options: A) were / have dedicated
B) should have been / dedicate
C) are / had dedicated
D) would be / are dedicating
E) have been / will have dedicated

questions.questionText: 8. If the soldiers ---- at the beginning of the siege of Rhodes Island, they ---- to Crete or somewhere else with their treasures.
questions.explanation: Geçmişte gerçekleşmiş olan Rodos Adası kuşatmasından bahsedildiği için bu bir Type 3 (Past Unreal) If koşuludur. Cümle, 'teslim olsalardı (had surrendered), taşınmış olabilirlerdi (might have been transported)' şeklindedir.
options: A) surrender / must have been transported
B) would surrender / could be transported
C) had surrendered / might have been transported
D) used to surrender / could have transported
E) could surrender / should have been transported

questions.questionText: 9. A new type of airport X-ray scanner ---- lately by an innovative company ---- the contents of bottles.
questions.explanation: 'Lately' (son zamanlarda) zaman zarfı Present Perfect Tense (has been built) kullanımını gerektirir. Şişelerin içeriğini 'tespit etmek için/amacıyla' demek için ise to-infinitive (to detect) kullanılır.
options: A) has been built / to detect
B) was built / to have detected
C) will be built / being detected
D) had been built / having detected
E) is built / to be detected

questions.questionText: 10. The study of visual illusions is critical ---- understanding the basic mechanisms of sensory perception and advancing cures ---- neurological diseases.
questions.explanation: Bir şey 'için' kritik olmak anlamında 'critical to/for' kullanılır. Ayrıca nörolojik hastalıklar 'için' tedaviler (cures for) anlamına gelen edat dizilimi D şıkkındadır.
options: A) off / toward
B) at / with
C) in / about
D) to / for
E) on / from

questions.questionText: 11. ---- the chaos that arose after the political and economic changes in the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics, the newly formed republics were anxious to make deals ---- foreign investors.
questions.explanation: Sovyetler Birliği'ndeki siyasi ve ekonomik değişimlerin ardından ortaya çıkan kaos 'sırasında' (During) ve yabancı yatırımcılar 'ile' (with) anlaşmalar yapmak anlamı uymaktadır.
options: A) During / with
B) After / upon
C) Through / off
D) Before / into
E) Until / from

questions.questionText: 12. By the age of three, a child's brain is almost fully grown ---- her bones and muscles are still underdeveloped.
questions.explanation: Üç yaşına gelindiğinde bir çocuğun beyninin neredeyse tamamen büyümesi ile kemiklerinin ve kaslarının hala tam gelişmemiş olması arasında bir zıtlık söz konusudur. Bu zıtlığı 'fakat / ancak' (but) bağlar.
options: A) since
B) but
C) if
D) unless
E) once

questions.questionText: 13. ---- the world has been changing more rapidly than ever before, managers and other employees throughout an organization must perform at higher and higher levels.
questions.explanation: Dünya her zamankinden daha hızlı değiştiği 'için / -den dolayı' (Because), yöneticiler ve çalışanlar sürekli daha yüksek seviyelerde performans göstermelidir (Sebep-sonuç ilişkisi).
options: A) Because
B) In case
C) As if
D) Although
E) Unless

questions.questionText: 14. ---- evidence of the civilization of the ancient Egypt was apparent everywhere, little was known of its detailed history until its hieroglyphic writing was deciphered in the early 19th century.
questions.explanation: Eski Mısır uygarlığının kanıtları her yerde belirgin olmasına RAĞMEN (Although), 19. yüzyılın başlarında hiyeroglif yazısı çözülene kadar tarihi hakkında çok az şey biliniyordu.
options: A) Since
B) Just as
C) Although
D) Given that
E) Only if

questions.questionText: 15. One central question in acupuncture is ---- needles reduce pain ---- patients are simply responding to suggestions.
questions.explanation: Akupunkturda iğnelerin ağrıyı azaltıp azaltmadığı (whether) 'yoksa' (or) hastaların sadece telkinlere mi yanıt verdiği sorusu ikili 'whether ... or' kalıbıyla ifade edilir.
options: A) whether / or
B) neither / nor
C) either / or
D) so / that
E) as / as

questions.questionText: 16. Being very significant ---- economical and geopolitical aspects, control of the Bosphorus was always demanded by many countries.
questions.explanation: İstanbul Boğazı'nın ekonomik ve jeopolitik yönler 'açısından / bakımından' (in terms of) çok önemli olması vurgulanmaktadır.
options: A) in spite of
B) rather than
C) instead of
D) regardless of
E) in terms of

questions.questionText: 17. To look inside an ant nest is to think about an alien civilization. The busy mass of worker ants (17)---- an upturned stone is both strangely similar to human society and strikingly different.
questions.explanation: Ters çevrilmiş bir taşın 'altında' (beneath) bulunan meşgul işçi karıncalar kütlesinden bahsedilmektedir.
options: A) beneath
B) off
C) towards
D) against
E) through

questions.questionText: 18. (18)---- us, ants build structures, find food, defend their societies and manage waste.
questions.explanation: 'Tıpkı bizim gibi' (Like us) karıncalar da yapılar inşa eder, yiyecek bulur ve toplumlarını savunurlar.
options: A) Despite
B) Instead of
C) Due to
D) Like
E) Thanks to

questions.questionText: 19. They (19)---- well-organized to do all these.
questions.explanation: Tüm bu karmaşık sosyal davranışları yapabilmeleri için çok iyi organize 'olmaları gerekir / olmuş olmalılar' (must be) şeklinde yüksek olasılık/kesinlik bildiren modal kullanılır.
options: A) must be
B) used to be
C) should have been
D) will have been
E) might be

questions.questionText: 20. But ants (20)---- this familiar end result in a very different way to humans.
questions.explanation: İnsanlara benzemelerine rağmen, karıncalar bu tanıdık nihai sonuca insanlardan çok farklı bir yolla 'ulaşırlar/gerçekleştirirler' (achieve).
options: A) defeat
B) regret
C) achieve
D) select
E) host

questions.questionText: 21. Human societies have centralized control. In other words, someone tells us what to do. Ants, (21)----, have decentralized control, and neither the queen nor any other ant directs work.
questions.explanation: İnsanların merkezi kontrolü varken, 'buna karşılık / aksine' (in contrast) karıncaların merkezi olmayan bir kontrolü vardır.
options: A) in contrast
B) in addition
C) accordingly
D) for instance
E) in short

questions.questionText: 22. There is an important difference between good teaching and effective teaching. Good teaching refers to a process of instruction (22)---- effective teaching refers to the outcomes of instruction.
questions.explanation: İyi öğretimin sürece atıfta bulunduğu, etkili öğretimin İSE/BUNA KARŞILIK (while/whereas) öğretimin sonuçlarına atıfta bulunduğu zıtlıkla anlatılmıştır.
options: A) while
B) provided that
C) even if
D) because
E) until

questions.questionText: 23. Among other things, a good teacher is one who provides a review at the start of a new lesson, states reasonable objectives, (23)---- an appropriate level of lesson difficulty...
questions.explanation: İyi öğretmenin, uygun bir ders zorluğu seviyesini 'sürdürdüğü/koruduğu' (maintains) ifade edilmektedir.
options: A) disputes
B) conquers
C) renews
D) maintains
E) claims

questions.questionText: 24. ... engages students in the learning process (24)---- emphasizing important points during instruction.
questions.explanation: Öğrencileri öğrenme sürecine dahil etmenin 'yanı sıra / ilaveten' (as well as) önemli noktaları vurguladığı belirtilir.
options: A) except for
B) in spite of
C) owing to
D) as well as
E) instead of

questions.questionText: 25. But effective teaching goes one step (25)---- the process of teaching. It focuses on whether students actually learn from instruction.
questions.explanation: Etkili öğretimin, öğretim sürecinin bir adım 'ötesine' (beyond) geçtiği ifade ediliyor.
options: A) under
B) against
C) beyond
D) without
E) off

questions.questionText: 26. An effective teacher is, therefore, one whose students learn what they (26)----.
questions.explanation: Etkili bir öğretmen, öğrencileri kendilerine 'öğretilen' (have been taught) şeyi öğrenen kişidir.
options: A) should have been taught
B) had been taught
C) was taught
D) might have been taught
E) have been taught

questions.questionText: 27. Although the Internet can present threats ----.
questions.explanation: İnternet tehditler sunabilmesine RAĞMEN (Although), 'psikolojik araştırmalar çoğu insanın interneti sosyal ilişkilerini ve kişisel refahını geliştirecek şekilde kullandığını göstermektedir' zıtlığı cümleyi tamamlar.
options: A) psychological research suggests that most people use the Internet in ways to enhance their social relationships and personal well-being
B) growing numbers of people are reluctant to rely on e-mail both for business and keeping in touch with friends and relatives
C) critics worry that the Internet typically offers more than superficial contact with strangers
D) the fact that young people often know more about computers than their parents do can add to concerns
E) computer use can account for the low academic achievement of students

questions.questionText: 28. Even if DNA may have influence on our moral character ----.
questions.explanation: DNA'nın ahlaki karakterimiz üzerinde etkisi olabilse BİLE (Even if), 'sosyal ve kültürel çevremizin ürünleri olduğumuza yaygın olarak inanılır' tezatlığı anlamı en iyi tamamlar.
options: A) it is widely believed that we are products of our social and cultural environment
B) such moral understandings are often regulated by religious and legal taboos of various kinds
C) thinking of ethics often begins with assumptions about human nature
D) people debate whether being moral is simply a matter of obeying social norms
E) the story of ethics is to some extent a description of attempts to legalize morality

questions.questionText: 29. As long as there are sufficiently large volumes of information ----.
questions.explanation: Yeterince büyük hacimde bilgi olduğu SÜRECE (As long as), 'bir makinenin karmaşık şeyler yapmayı öğrenmesini sağlamak kolaydır' (AI bağlamında bir koşul-sonuç).
options: A) it is easy to get a machine to learn to do complicated things
B) the complexity arises from the vast numbers of connections within the system
C) human-like machines have begun to influence every realm of life
D) people would need to change their ideas about what artificial intelligence means
E) people have expressed their concerns about privacy in an age of computerised systems

questions.questionText: 30. As the age of children rises, needing less care ----.
questions.explanation: Çocukların yaşı ilerledikçe (As) daha az bakıma ihtiyaç duyarlar, bu sayede 'anneler yarı zamanlı çalışmadan yavaş yavaş tam zamanlı çalışmaya geçebilirler'.
options: A) mothers pay more attention to the quality of pre-school education
B) mothers who have more than two children tend to have some psychological problems
C) part-time work has developed because of women's preference to work more
D) mothers can gradually shift from part-time to full-time work
E) the low level of care provided by governments becomes an important factor

questions.questionText: 31. In spite of the current Japanese dominance of the region ----.
questions.explanation: Mevcut Japonya'nın bölgedeki hakimiyetine RAĞMEN (In spite of), 'Asya'daki Çin merkezli ekonomi hızla endüstri ve ticaret için yeni bir merkez olarak ortaya çıkıyor'.
options: A) the importance of regional economic blocs is likely to continue to increase in Tokyo
B) the China-based economy of Asia is rapidly emerging as a new centre for industry and commerce
C) Japan is one of the world's most unstable geological zones, and Japan experiences more than 1,000 earthquakes per year
D) culture and religion can also form different types of national sub-groups
E) Japan has had an enviable record for growth and prosperity

questions.questionText: 32. Spending money on others can provide happiness ----.
questions.explanation: Başkalarına para harcamak, 'kendi zor kazandığınız nakdinizi kullandığınızda bile' (even when you use your own hard-earned cash) mutluluk sağlayabilir.
options: A) even when you use your own hard-earned cash
B) once people in poor countries have tried to meet their own basic needs
C) although the tendency to experience joy from helping is part of human nature
D) after children can get pleasure from helping others
E) whereas charities make it easy for donors to see how their contributions are used

questions.questionText: 33. All parents struggle to find the right balance between encouragement and discipline ----.
questions.explanation: Bütün ebeveynler 'çocuklarını yetiştirmeye gelince' (when it comes to raising their kids) teşvik ve disiplin arasında doğru dengeyi bulmakta zorlanırlar.
options: A) when it comes to raising their kids
B) although they already know the causes
C) since they have accomplished this important duty
D) because neighbours always complain about their children
E) as children need to be loved by their parents

questions.questionText: 34. ---- your body will be supplied with higher levels of energy and become more resistant to diseases.
questions.explanation: 'Brokoli ve lahana gibi vitamin açısından zengin sebzeleri tüketmeye alıştıktan SONRA' (Once you get used to consuming...), vücudunuza daha yüksek seviyelerde enerji sağlanacak ve hastalıklara karşı daha dirençli hale gelecektir.
options: A) Just as a number of supplements can be used to make up for calcium deficiency
B) Even if you change your eating habits and avoid living a stressful life
C) Although you have routine blood-pressure or cholesterol level checks
D) Once you get used to consuming vitamin-rich vegetables like broccoli and cabbage
E) Unless you strengthen your muscles and bones through regular exercise

questions.questionText: 35. Parasites live on or inside other living beings ----.
questions.explanation: Parazitlerin diğer canlıların üzerinde veya içinde yaşadığı, 've insanların içinde yaşayabilen 1.000'den fazla tür olduğu' (and there are more than 1,000 types that can live inside humans) ifade edilmiştir.
options: A) and there are more than 1,000 types that can live inside humans
B) so some animals prefer to spend most of their time alone
C) although animals are the only living things with muscles and nerves for movement and sensation
D) because defensive animals have avoidance methods such as speed and colour
E) but the heat of cold-blooded animals comes from outside the body

questions.questionText: 36. We often forget the value of things surrounding us ----.
questions.explanation: Bizi çevreleyen şeylerin değerini sık sık unuturuz, 've kültürümüzü ancak bir yabancının gözünden görüldüğünde yeniden değerlendiririz' (and only when seen through the eyes of a foreigner do we revalue our culture) mantığı doğru geçiştir.
options: A) for some aspects of life inspire pride in our cultural heritage
B) even if people avoid paying attention to old crafts and skills that were once crucial
C) and only when seen through the eyes of a foreigner do we revalue our culture
D) since some common interactions fail
E) while reading historical accounts

questions.questionText: 37. Textbooks are viewed as a means of presenting established bodies of knowledge to students.
questions.explanation: İngilizce cümlenin ana yüklemi 'are viewed as a means of presenting...' (takdim eden araçlar olarak görülür), öznesi ise 'Textbooks' (Ders kitapları)'dur. A şıkkı bu yapıyı eksiksiz olarak karşılar.
options: A) Ders kitapları, yerleşmiş olan bilgiyi öğrencilere takdim eden araçlar olarak görülür.
B) Yerleşmiş olan bilgi, öğrencilere ders kitapları aracılığıyla aktarılmaktadır.
C) Ders kitapları bilgiyi aktarma görevine sahiptir.
D) Öğrencilere sunulan bilginin asıl aracı ders kitaplarıdır.
E) Ders kitaplarındaki yerleşmiş bilgi aktarılmalıdır.

questions.questionText: 38. People who have difficulty in eating because of illness are advised to have concentrated liquid formulas since they are easily swallowed.
questions.explanation: Cümle: 'Hastalık nedeniyle yemek yemekte güçlük çeken kişilere, kolayca yutulabildikleri için konsantre sıvı formüller almaları tavsiye edilir.' A şıkkı: 'Konsantre sıvı formüller yutkunmada herhangi bir zorluğa neden olmadığı için (As concentrated liquid formulas do not cause any difficulty...), hastalık nedeniyle yemek yeme zorluğu çeken insanlara bunları kullanmaları tavsiye edilir (people who find it hard to eat due to illness are advised to use them).' yapısal ve anlamsal tam bir çeviridir.
options: A) As concentrated liquid formulas do not cause any difficulty in swallowing, people who find it hard to eat due to illness are advised to use them.
B) Concentrated liquid formulas are very practical to swallow, so they are recommended to ill people, especially those who have problems with eating.
C) If a person cannot eat easily because of illness, he or she should have concentrated liquid formulas, as illness affects them immensely.
D) Illness may cause difficulty in eating, but people can overcome it using concentrated liquid formulas that are easy to swallow.
E) Concentrated liquid formulas contribute a lot to solving the problem of eating resulting from illness, as they are convenient for easy swallowing.

questions.questionText: 39. How much vision is affected by a cataract depends on the intensity of light entering the eye and the location of the cataract.
questions.explanation: 'Görüşün katarakt tarafından ne kadar etkilendiği' (How much vision is affected by a cataract), 'bağlıdır' (depends on), 'göze giren ışığın yoğunluğuna ve kataraktın yerine' (the intensity of light entering the eye and the location of the cataract). E şıkkı eksiksiz bir çeviridir.
options: A) Katarakt, bulunduğu yere ve göze giren ışığın ne kadar yoğun olduğuna bağlı olarak görüşü etkiler.
B) Katarakt nedeniyle görüş, göze giren ışığın yoğunluğuna ve kataraktın yerine bağlı olarak etkilenir.
C) Göze giren ışığın yoğunluğu ve kataraktın bulunduğu yer, kataraktlı gözde görüşün ne kadar etkilendiğini belirler.
D) Görüşün katarakt nedeniyle etkilenip etkilenmediği, göze giren ışığın yoğunluğuna ve kataraktın bulunduğu yere göre değişir.
E) Görüşün katarakt tarafından ne kadar etkilendiği, göze giren ışığın yoğunluğuna ve kataraktın yerine bağlıdır.

questions.questionText: 40. As it is both time-consuming and unhealthy, one of the things that should be avoided as much as possible while cooking some vegetables is boiling them.
questions.explanation: 'Hem zaman alıcı hem de sağlıksız olduğu için' (As it is both time-consuming and unhealthy), 'bazı sebzeleri pişirirken mümkün olduğunca kaçınılması gereken şeylerden biri' (one of the things that should be avoided as much as possible while cooking some vegetables), 'onları haşlamaktır' (is boiling them). B şıkkı bu ifadeyi tam olarak İngilizce'ye çevirmiştir.
options: A) Since boiling some vegetables is both time-consuming and unhealthy, you should avoid them as much as possible.
B) As it is both time-consuming and unhealthy, one of the things that should be avoided as much as possible while cooking some vegetables is boiling them.
C) The only way of cooking some vegetables to be avoided as much as possible is boiling them, because boiling is both time-consuming and unhealthy.
D) Both time-consuming and unhealthy, boiling must be avoided as much as possible while cooking some vegetables.
E) Although boiling some vegetables is both time-consuming and unhealthy, it cannot be avoided in some situations.

questions.questionText: 41. 2010'da yapılan bir araştırma, on yıl düzenli olarak cep telefonu kullanmış olan kişilerin belirli tümörlerin gelişiminde daha büyük bir riskle karşı karşıya olduklarını ortaya çıkarmıştır.
questions.explanation: '2010'da yapılan bir araştırma ... ortaya çıkarmıştır' (A study carried out in 2010 revealed that...), 'on yıl düzenli olarak cep telefonu kullanmış olan kişilerin' (people who have used mobile phones regularly for 10 years), 'belirli tümörlerin gelişiminde daha büyük bir riskle karşı karşıya olduklarını' (face a higher risk of developing certain tumours). A şıkkı birebir çeviridir.
options: A) A study carried out in 2010 revealed that people who have used mobile phones regularly for 10 years face a higher risk of developing certain tumours.
B) A study that was carried out in 2010 suggests that people who have used mobile phones constantly for 10 years are in greater danger of developing certain tumours.
C) In 2010, a study was carried out revealing the fact that people who face a higher risk of developing certain tumours are the ones who have used mobile phones regularly for 10 years.
D) People who have used mobile phones for 10 years face a higher risk of developing certain tumours, and this was revealed by a study carried out in 2010.
E) In 2010, it was found in a study that people who used mobile phones periodically for 10 years faced a higher risk of developing certain tumours.

questions.questionText: 42. 20. yüzyılda Birleşik Devletler'de meydana gelen ortalama yaşam süresindeki 30 yıllık artış, iyileştirilen tıbbi bakım sayesindeydi.
questions.explanation: '20. yüzyılda Birleşik Devletler'de meydana gelen ortalama yaşam süresindeki 30 yıllık artış' (The 30-year increase in life expectancy that occurred in the United States during the 20th century), 'iyileştirilen tıbbi bakım sayesindeydi / tıbbi bakıma bağlıydı' (was due to improved medical care). B şıkkı en doğru çeviridir.
options: A) Improved medical care contributed to a 30-year increase in life expectancy that occurred in the United States during the 20th century.
B) The 30-year increase in life expectancy that occurred in the United States during the 20th century was due to improved medical care.
C) The 20th century saw a 30-year increase in life expectancy in the United States owing to improved medical care.
D) Thanks to improved medical care, a 30-year increase in life expectancy occurred in the United States in the 20th century.
E) In the 20th century, there occurred a 30-year increase in life expectancy in the United States because of improved medical care.

questions.questionText: 43. It can be inferred from the passage that ----.
questions.explanation: Metinde Bangladeş'teki 8 katlı hazır giyim fabrikası Rana Plaza'nın yapısal olarak kusurlu (structurally deficient) olduğu ve çöküşünün küresel sonuçları olduğu belirtilmiştir. Bu da binanın 'düzgün inşa edilmediği' (was not properly constructed) sonucunu doğurur.
options: A) the collapse of the Rana Plaza drew more attention worldwide
B) there were far more workers in the Rana Plaza than the building could handle
C) the Rana Plaza was not properly constructed
D) the Bangladeshi government has always prioritized the conditions of workers in the RMG industry
E) the workers in the Rana Plaza did not have a reputation for producing high-quality garments

questions.questionText: 44. It is clear from the passage that ----.
questions.explanation: Metinde Bangladeş'in hazır giyim (RMG) endüstrisinin, ülkenin ihracatının yaklaşık %80'inden sorumlu olduğu (responsible for nearly 80% of the country's exports) yazılıdır. Bu da hazır giyimin ihracatta en büyük payı oluşturduğu anlamına gelir.
options: A) there are 4 million undereducated villagers in Bangladesh, still waiting to be employed
B) China produces better quality garments than Bangladesh
C) the RMG industry had to be halted in Bangladesh after the collapse
D) ready-made garments comprise the largest share of Bangladesh's exports
E) workers in the industry receive extra payments

questions.questionText: 45. What did the photographer and the reporter do after the collapse of Rana Plaza?
questions.explanation: Metinde çöküşten altı hafta sonra bir fotoğrafçı ve muhabirin bir araya gelerek hayatta kalanların ve kurbanların geçmiş hikayelerini ve nasıl yaşayıp öldüklerini izlemek için 'felaket bölgesine geri döndükleri' (trace the backstories of the Rana Plaza survivors...) anlatılmaktadır.
options: A) They have been blamed for exploiting the disaster.
B) They did business with the big brand companies.
C) They tried to keep the truth hidden.
D) They went back into the disaster area six weeks after the collapse to find out about the workers.
E) They proved that there are very few governmental controls in the RMG industry.

questions.questionText: 46. The author points out that the RMG-workers in Bangladesh differ from other developing-country workers in that ----.
questions.explanation: Bangladeşli işçilerin, diğer gelişmekte olan ülkelerdeki işçilerin şehre göç modelini izledikleri, ancak onları ayıran şeyin (What sets Bangladeshi garment workers apart is...) iş başında depresif bir sıklıkla hayatlarını kaybetmeleri (lose their lives on the job with depressing frequency) olduğu söylenmiştir. Bu, aralarındaki ölüm oranlarının daha yüksek olduğu (the mortality rates among them are higher) anlamına gelir.
options: A) they are brave enough to leave their villages
B) the mortality rates among them are higher
C) they dedicate their work to later generations
D) they are not intimidated by uncertainties in the city
E) they need to work much harder and longer hours

questions.questionText: 47. The study mentioned in the passage reveals that ----.
questions.explanation: Araştırma, dış koşullardan ziyade küçük kişilik değişikliklerinin (small personality shifts) yaşam doyumuyla daha yakından bağlantılı olduğunu (more closely tied to life satisfaction) ortaya koymuştur. Bu da 'zaman içindeki belirli kişilik değişimlerinin yaşam doyumuna katkıda bulunabileceği' (certain shifts in personality over time can contribute to life satisfaction) fikrini verir.
options: A) a person's personality remains stable from early adulthood to old age
B) certain shifts in personality over time can contribute to life satisfaction
C) among the Big Five personality traits, openness and extroversion start to decline in old age
D) greater job satisfaction decreases neuroticism and increases extroversion
E) some personality traits are more prone to change than others

questions.questionText: 48. It is understood from the passage that an increase in openness is ----.
questions.explanation: Metinde 'daha açık hale gelen (more open) kişilerin yaşamda daha fazla memnuniyet (greater contentment) bildirdikleri' ifade ediliyor. Bu da açıklıktaki artışın hayatta daha fazla mutlulukla sonuçlanmasının beklendiği (expected to result in more happiness in life) anlamına gelir.
options: A) the outcome of stronger relationships
B) a consequence of personal contentment
C) expected to result in more happiness in life
D) enhanced by greater job satisfaction
E) considered as the most important personality trait

questions.questionText: 49. It can be inferred from the passage that ----.
questions.explanation: Metin, medeni durum veya çalışma durumu gibi deneyimlediğimiz dışsal faktörlerin yanı sıra travmalar veya kişilik özelliklerindeki değişikliklerin de (changes in personality traits) yaşam doyumu üzerinde etkiye sahip olduğunu (have an effect on life satisfaction) anlatmaktadır.
options: A) personality change occurs mainly in combat soldiers, and they become more agreeable individuals
B) psychological trauma is the main reason why we experience shifts in personality traits
C) what we experience as well as changes in personality traits have an effect on life satisfaction
D) demographic factors, such as marital status or employment do not change as much as personality traits among older adults
E) self-reports from people aged 15 to 93 suggest that adult personality is static after a certain age

questions.questionText: 50. What could be the best title for the passage?
questions.explanation: Metin genel olarak kişilikte zamanla meydana gelen değişikliklerin (örneğin açıklık veya uyumluluktaki değişimler) yaşam doyumunu ve mutluluğu nasıl etkilediğini incelediğinden, 'Kişilik Değişikliklerine Bağlı Yaşam Doyumu' (Life Satisfaction Linked to Personality Changes) en iyi başlıktır.
options: A) How We Grow over Time
B) How to Change our Personality Traits
C) Economic Concerns versus Life Satisfaction
D) Life Satisfaction Linked to Personality Changes
E) Forces of Personality Change

questions.questionText: 51. According to the passage, Roman baths ----.
questions.explanation: Metnin ilk cümlesinde antik çalışmalardaki hem yeni başlayanların hem de uzmanların Roma toplumunda yıkanmanın neden bu kadar önemli olduğunu sık sık sordukları belirtilmiştir. Bu da onların 'antik çalışmalardaki uzmanlar ve yeni başlayanlar tarafından ilgi çekici bulunduğunu' (are found interesting by both beginners and specialists in ancient studies) gösterir.
options: A) had to wait till the end of the Republic to achieve its deserved popularity
B) are found interesting by both beginners and specialists in ancient studies
C) were the place for Romans to go on occasions when they did not prefer siesta for their leisure
D) in both town and country had the same design as well as abundance
E) became a significant part of the daily life, resulting in the formation of an institution to run public baths

questions.questionText: 52. It is clear from the passage that what made Roman baths an indispensable part of the life ----.
questions.explanation: Metinde Roma hamamlarının neden günlük bir alışkanlık olduğu açıklanırken; fiziksel ve psikolojik olarak tatmin edici olması (pleasure factor), sağlık için iyi görülmesi ve karlı bir iş (economic explanation) olması sayılmıştır. Bu da nedenin ekonomik, fiziksel ve psikolojik refahla ilgili sebeplerin bir kombinasyonu olduğunu (is a combination of reasons related to economic, physical and psychological well-being) gösterir.
options: A) had a lot to do with the fact that Romans failed to find any leisure activities other than siesta
B) is a combination of reasons related to economic, physical and psychological well-being
C) focussed specifically on health benefits of the activity itself
D) still applies to modern bath cultures today
E) remains a mystery for the ancient world

questions.questionText: 53. It is pointed out in the passage that the belief that baths were good for health ----.
questions.explanation: Metinde 'Yıkanmak ciddi bir terapötik önlem olarak kabul ediliyordu ve antik tıptan tam destek aldı' (received full support from ancient medicine) ifadesi yer almaktadır.
options: A) was rejected by ancient physicians who viewed it as merely leisure
B) lacked any solid therapeutic reasoning behind it
C) was fully supported by ancient medicine
D) was a myth fabricated by businessmen to increase profits
E) decreased after the end of the Roman Republic

questions.questionText: 54. What could be the best title for the passage?
questions.explanation: Paragraf antik Roma'da yıkanmanın neden bu kadar önemli bir alışkanlık olduğu (fizyolojik, sağlık, ekonomik nedenleri) üzerinde durmaktadır. Bu sebeple 'Roma Hamam Kültürünün Popülaritesi' (Popularity of Roman Bathing Culture) en uygun başlıktır.
options: A) Development of Roman Baths
B) Bathing Rituals and Activities in Ancient Rome
C) Popularity of Roman Bathing Culture
D) Architecture of Roman Baths
E) Differences between Urban and Country Baths in Ancient Rome

questions.questionText: 55. The couple mentioned in the passage ----.
questions.explanation: Nicole ve kocası banyo tadilatı yerine safariye gitme kararı aldılar ve 'on yıllık bilimsel araştırma, onların bu kararlarının ardındaki şaşırtıcı bilgeliği ortaya koyuyor' (reveals the surprising wisdom of their decision). Bu da deneyimlerinden ötürü aldıkları karardan memnun olduklarını (were satisfied with the decision they made) gösterir.
options: A) had to spend a lot more money than they had originally intended when they went on a safari
B) had already been seeking out memorable activities before they bought a house
C) were satisfied with the decision they made when its consequences are taken into account
D) would have been more pleased if they had renovated their bathroom instead of going on a safari
E) were invited to take part in more safaris after their pleasant experiences

questions.questionText: 56. One can infer from the passage that ----.
questions.explanation: Metinde insanların maddi şeyler satın almaktansa deneyim satın almaktan daha fazla mutluluk duydukları (people get more happiness from buying experiences than buying material things) belirtilmiştir. B şıkkı bu ifadeyle birebir uyuşur.
options: A) when compared with experiential purchases, material purchases cost a lot more
B) people are more likely to enjoy spending money on experiences than purchasing material goods
C) the author is opposed to the idea that experiencing unusual events can make us feel happier than buying things
D) material purchases have long lasting effects while experiential purchases do not
E) people should be better prepared when they make material purchases

questions.questionText: 57. Getting a kiss from a giraffe ----.
questions.explanation: Safarideyken zürafa tarafından öpülmenin, 'yeni bir banyoya sahip olmaktan çok daha şaşırtıcı bir hikaye sunduğu' (makes for a more surprising story than having a new bathroom) vurgulanmıştır. Bu da arkadaşlarla paylaşılabilecek alışılmadık bir deneyimi sembolize ettiği anlamına gelir.
options: A) symbolizes an unusual experience to be shared with friends
B) was what made Nicole and Dean love safaris
C) costs more than renovating one's old bathroom
D) is less of a topic to talk with strangers than mend the bathroom
E) is encouraged by the staff of University of Colorado

questions.questionText: 58. What could be the best title for this passage?
questions.explanation: Paragrafta banyo yaptırmak gibi 'maddi' bir yatırım yerine safariye çıkmak gibi 'deneyimsel' bir alımın insanlara daha fazla mutluluk ve anlatılacak hikaye verdiği anlatıldığından 'Deneyimlerin Maddi Mallara Üstünlüğü' (The Superiority of Experiences over Material Goods) çok uygundur.
options: A) The Superiority of Experiences over Material Goods
B) When to Make Profitable Purchases
C) The Studies on Couples' Spending Choices
D) How Choices Influence Marriage
E) The Effects of Material Goods on Our Lives

questions.questionText: 59. It is pointed out in the passage that the polygraph ----.
questions.explanation: Metinde yalan makinesinin yalanları değil, ancak belirli duyguların sonucu olan fiziksel değişiklikleri tespit ettiği (detects not lies, but physical changes that are the results of specific emotions) belirtiliyor.
options: A) is a reliable device used in various fields
B) can detect effectively when someone is notably telling lies
C) measures physical changes in the body triggered by emotion
D) is better at detecting guilty people than those who are innocent
E) has a very complicated application, which makes it hard to detect people who react very quickly

questions.questionText: 60. According to the passage, ----.
questions.explanation: Şüphelilerin uyuşturucu kullanarak veya tekniklerle yalan makinesini atlatabilecekleri anlatılıyor. Ayrıca testlerin 'son derece güvenilmez ve amacına ters düşen' (highly unreliable but counterproductive) olabileceği vurgulandığı için makinenin birinin kesinlikle suçlu olup olmadığını kanıtlayamayacağı (cannot prove precisely if someone is guilty or not) ortaya çıkar.
options: A) the polygraph cannot prove precisely if someone is guilty or not
B) drug addicts tend to perform better on the test
C) detecting emotional changes is easier than physiological ones
D) the polygraph detects not only lies but also physical changes in the body
E) the polygraph is the latest development in lie detection, which has been quite popular

questions.questionText: 61. One can conclude from the passage that ----.
questions.explanation: Paragrafın sonunda, yalan makinesinin (polygraph) mevcut haliyle ilaçlar ve eğitimlerle yanıltılabildiği, bu nedenle masumları dışlayıp suçluların kaçmasına izin verdiği belirtiliyor. Bu durum onun kullanılacaksa daha fazla iyileştirmeye ihtiyacı olduğunu (if the polygraph is to be used, it requires far more improvement) gösterir.
options: A) the polygraph is able to keep records for a long time
B) the parts of the body to which sensors will be attached should be determined faultlessly
C) there has been a dramatic increase in the number of drugs used to fake the polygraph
D) so many people have been trained to detect lies
E) if the polygraph is to be used, it requires far more improvement

questions.questionText: 62. It can be understood from the passage that the author ----.
questions.explanation: Yazar, yalan makinesinin aslında yalanları değil vücuttaki fizyolojik değişimleri ölçtüğünü, uyuşturucuyla veya eğitimle kolayca manipüle edilebildiğini ('highly unreliable') anlatarak onun güvenilirliğinin neden şüpheye açık olduğunu ('tries to explain why the use of polygraph is open to doubt') açıklamaktadır.
options: A) tries to explain why the use of polygraph is open to doubt
B) criticizes courts using the polygraph as a proof
C) favours the use of the polygraph even though it causes ambiguity
D) informs the reader that the polygraph, on its own, is able to both record and detect accurately
E) aims to encourage people to use the polygraph for specific purposes

questions.questionText:
63. Martin: I read Tom Jenkinson has built his entire career out of doing the unexpected. 
 Jack: ---- 
 Martin: No, not necessarily. I think he doesn't want to repeat himself or imitate his predecessors. 
 Jack: It must be really interesting and challenging for him.
questions.explanation: Martin, Tom Jenkinson'ın kendisini tekrarlamak istemediğini (No, not necessarily. I think he doesn't want to repeat himself...) söylediği için, Jack'in 'Tüm hayatı başkalarını şaşırtmaya mı dayanıyor demek istiyorsun?' (Does it mean that his all life is based on surprising the others?) sorusu konuşmayı mantıklı bir şekilde birbirine bağlar.
options: A) I'm sure teenage girls are passionate fans of him.
B) That sounds disappointing. Why bother to please others?
C) It is just the atmosphere of the scenes that makes him so amazing.
D) Does it mean that his all life is based on surprising the others?
E) Then, he must be really proud of himself.

questions.questionText:
64. Ceyhun: I haven't been feeling very well for a long time. I've tried hard but cannot help feeling less and less happy. 
 Kemal: It sounds like depression. Maybe you need some changes in your life. Experts believe that living in the country may be relaxing for your mind. 
 Ceyhun: ---- 
 Kemal: I quite agree with you. I hope you'll be alright soon.
questions.explanation: Kemal, Ceyhun'a köyde/kırsalda yaşamanın zihni için rahatlatıcı olabileceğini tavsiye ediyor. Ceyhun buna onaylayıcı bir cevap ('İlginç, bu mantıklı. Belki de emekliliğime ve bir köye yerleşmeye daha çok odaklanmalıyım') vermelidir ki Kemal 'Sana tamamen katılıyorum' (I quite agree with you) diyerek diyalogu olumlu tamamlasın.
options: A) Interesting, that makes sense. Perhaps I should now focus more on my retirement and settling down in a village.
B) Do you really think I'm going to suffer from depression? I wonder whether you know any psychologists I can see.
C) So that means living in the countryside will refresh me, as it may provide wonderful views. Yet, I can't decide what to do.
D) I'm not ready to give up my urban living. I suspect those experts haven't made an evidence-based comparison of urban living and country living.
E) It must be due to plenty of stress factors in cities. I've heard of many studies confirming the link between social strain and mental illness.

questions.questionText:
65. Allison: ---- 
 Jill: I'd recommend you to study the latter since it is a language spoken worldwide, with official status in a great number of countries, holding the second place only after English. 
 Allison: Wow, I didn't know that it had that many speakers around the world. 
 Jill: Yes, and besides, I think you will find it much easier considering you can also speak French, having an extensive amount of vocabulary in common.
questions.explanation: Jill, Allison'a 'ikincisini' (the latter) okumasını tavsiye ediyor çünkü dünyada çok yaygın konuşulduğunu söylüyor (Spanish/İspanyolca kastediliyor). Allison'ın giriş cümlesinde iki seçenek arasında kaldığını belirtmesi gerekir. E şıkkındaki 'Yeni bir dil öğrenmeye karar verdim ama Almanca ile İspanyolca arasında kaldım' ifadesi cuk oturmaktadır.
options: A) I am so much interested in languages and linguistics that I want to learn about the evolution of languages but don't know with what to start.
B) My parents are going to support me if I plan to pursue an academic career abroad. But I can't decide where to go to study.
C) Do you have any idea which of the two is a more appropriate place for an international student: Brazil or Argentina?
D) I was considering how it would be settling in a totally new country once I get retired.
E) I have decided to learn a new language but I'm torn between German and Spanish.

questions.questionText:
66. Yavuz: Did you ever think about how huge the Universe really is? We're merely one small part of an enormous system. 
 Ebru: No, I haven't really given any thought to it. 
 Yavuz: ---- 
 Ebru: Oh, wow! And to think we are just a tiny speck in it! 
 Yavuz: I can't agree with you more!
questions.explanation: Ebru 'Vay canına! Ve içinde sadece küçük bir zerre olduğumuzu düşünmek!' diyerek hayretini belirtiyor. Yavuz'un evrenin devasa boyutuyla ilgili şaşırtıcı bir bilgi ('Sadece bizim galaksimiz Samanyolu bile milyarlarca yıldız içeriyor ve evrende de milyarlarca galaksi var' gibi) vermiş olması mantıklıdır. (Soru OCR eksikliğinden onarılmıştır, cevap anahtarına göre E'dir).
options: A) I think you should read a bit on this topic.
B) Is it really that important to know about space?
C) Do you care about it because it is fascinating?
D) Please try to pay attention when taking this astronomy class.
E) Well, our galaxy is just one of billions in the Universe.

questions.questionText:
67. Dilek: Do you think the digital age will bring an end to libraries? 
 Selin: ---- 
 Dilek: I never thought about it like that. So, you mean libraries actually encourage the digital age. 
 Selin: Exactly, the future offers hope by placing libraries in a broader context as key parts of the information society rather than just rooms full of books.
questions.explanation: Dilek, Selin'in cevabından yola çıkarak 'Yani kütüphanelerin aslında dijital çağı teşvik ettiğini kastediyorsun' çıkarımını yapıyor. Bu durumda Selin'in kütüphanelerin dijital çağla bitmeyeceğini, aksine teknolojiyle entegre bir bilgi merkezi haline geleceğini savunması gerekir. E şıkkındaki 'Kesinlikle hayır. Benim için kütüphaneler sadece kitaplardan ibaret değil; çok çeşitli ortamlar için bilgiye erişim merkezleridir' ifadesi mükemmel uyar.
options: A) I don't know, but to my mind, using a mouse to control a cursor is as important as learning to understand letters on a page.
B) I am not certain whether tomorrow's libraries will be able to offer access to the shared space of the network.
C) Today, some libraries are being handed over to voluntary groups or charities, so the answer of your questions depends on their steps.
D) Sooner or later, we'll find ourselves at a point in time where the library will either become extinct or evolve into something fitter for the modern age.
E) Definitely not. For me, libraries are more than just books; they are centers of information access for a wide range of media.

questions.questionText: 68. Crime is not unique to urban life, and violence occurs in families far more often than on the streets.
questions.explanation: 'Suç kentsel yaşama özgü değildir (not unique to urban life) ve şiddet ailelerde sokaklardan çok daha sık meydana gelir (occurs in families far more often than on the streets).' A şıkkı, 'Suç şehirlere özgü değildir (not peculiar to cities) ve evlerde sokaklardakinden daha fazla şiddet vardır' diyerek en yakın anlamı sağlar.
options: A) Crime is not peculiar to cities, and there is more violence at homes than on the streets.
B) Crime can be found everywhere except in cities, and street violence occurs less often than family violence.
C) It is impossible to say that crime is a feature of city life considering the fact that violence is seen in families rather than on the streets.
D) Street violence is not as common as family violence, which means crime is not only a part of urban life.
E) While crime is often associated with cities, family violence is much more prevalent than street violence.

questions.questionText: 69. People who have difficulty in eating because of illness are advised to have concentrated liquid formulas since they are easily swallowed.
questions.explanation: 'Hastalık nedeniyle yemek yemede zorluk çeken kişilere, kolayca yutulabildikleri için (since they are easily swallowed) konsantre sıvı formüller almaları önerilir.' A şıkkı: 'Konsantre sıvı formüller yutkunmada zorluğa neden olmadığı için, hastalık nedeniyle yemek yemeyi zor bulan kişilere bunları kullanmaları tavsiye edilir.' birebir karşılıktır.
options: A) As concentrated liquid formulas do not cause any difficulty in swallowing, people who find it hard to eat due to illness are advised to use them.
B) Concentrated liquid formulas are very practical to swallow, so they are recommended to ill people, especially those who have problems with eating.
C) If a person cannot eat easily because of illness, he or she should have concentrated liquid formulas, as illness affects them immensely.
D) Illness may cause difficulty in eating, but people can overcome it using concentrated liquid formulas that are easy to swallow.
E) Concentrated liquid formulas contribute a lot to solving the problem of eating resulting from illness, as they are convenient for easy swallowing.

questions.questionText: 70. The importance of language is not only that it allows us to communicate, but also that it gives us an identity, without which we would not know who we are.
questions.explanation: 'Dilin önemi sadece iletişim kurmamızı sağlaması değil, aynı zamanda onsuz kim olduğumuzu bilemeyeceğimiz bir kimlik kazandırmasıdır.' E şıkkı: 'Dil sadece iletişim kurmamızı sağladığı için değil (not only because...), aynı zamanda bize kim olduğumuzu bilmemizi sağlayan bir kimlik sağladığı için de önemlidir (...but also because it provides us with an identity, which enables us to know who we are)' diyerek en doğru aktarımı yapar.
options: A) Language, through which we can communicate, is important to our knowledge of who we are because it gives us an identity.
B) The reason why language is important is not that it allows us to communicate but that it enables us to have an identity with which we know who we are.
C) Language, with which we associate ourselves, is important because it both allows us to communicate and to know who we are.
D) If it were not for language, with which we can communicate and obtain our identity, we would not be able to know the importance of who we are.
E) Language is important not only because it allows us to communicate, but also because it provides us with an identity, which enables us to know who we are.

questions.questionText: 71. The way that scientists compare colour vision in different types of animals is by counting the colour photoreceptors in their eyes.
questions.explanation: 'Bilim insanlarının farklı türdeki hayvanlarda renkli görüşü karşılaştırma yolu, gözlerindeki renk fotoreseptörlerini saymaktır.' C şıkkı: 'Farklı hayvanların renkli görmelerini karşılaştırmak için (In order to compare...), bilim insanları hayvanların gözlerindeki renk fotoreseptörlerini sayarlar' diyerek amaç-yöntem kurgusunu doğru verir.
options: A) The colour vision of different animals can be compared by counting their photoreceptors, a method put forward by many scientists.
B) There are many ways of comparing the colour vision of different animals, yet scientists are mainly using one specific technique; counting the colour photoreceptors in their eyes.
C) In order to compare different animals' colour vision, scientists count the colour photoreceptors in the eyes of the animals.
D) If anyone is interested in making a comparison among animals' colour vision, they should count the colour photoreceptors in their eyes.
E) The colour photoreceptors in the eyes of different animals give lots of information about their colour vision, according to the scientists.

questions.questionText: 72. No one on the planet is going to escape the effects of global warming and for billions the resulting environmental deterioration is going to make life considerably more difficult. ---- The question is whether we will ever be able to achieve a worthwhile international consensus that allows us to do this with any degree of effectiveness.
questions.explanation: Metinde küresel ısınmadan kimsenin kaçamayacağı, milyarlarca insan için yaşamın zorlaşacağı söyleniyor. Son cümlede 'Soru, bunu herhangi bir etkililik derecesiyle yapmamıza olanak tanıyan faydalı bir uluslararası fikir birliğine varıp varamayacağımızdır' deniyor. 'Bunu yapmak' (do this) ifadesine atıf yapacak bir eylem gereklidir. B şıkkı 'Artık saati geri almak için çok geç, ancak (but we can at least attempt to reduce the worst impacts...) en azından en kötü etkileri azaltmaya çalışabiliriz' diyerek bu eylemi ('reduce') verir ve cümleyi çok iyi bağlar.
options: A) Without US ratification, emissions from all the industrial countries could rise significantly soon.
B) It is too late now to put the clock back, but we can at least attempt to reduce the worst impacts of global warming.
C) The more global warming continues to attract the public attention, the closer we are to finding a solution.
D) The latter includes ways of using the oceans as a dumping ground for atmospheric carbon dioxide.
E) In terms of greenhouse gas emissions, things are getting steadily worse, not better.

questions.questionText: 73. One of the first microscopes was built by a lensmaker in the Netherlands in 1590. It was a simple device with one lens. In 1625, Italian scientist Galileo Galilei made the first compound microscope. ---- The magnified view appears as a so-called 'virtual image' behind the target. Many microscopes today also have a light source behind the target to illuminate it.
questions.explanation: Galilei'nin 'bileşik mikroskop' (compound microscope) icat ettiği söyleniyor. Boşluktan sonra ise 'Büyütülmüş görünüm hedefin arkasında sanal bir görüntü olarak belirir' deniyor. Cihazın nasıl çalıştığına dair A şıkkındaki 'Hedefin bir görüntüsünü oluşturmak için bir merceği ve onu büyütmek için bir başkası (another to make it bigger) vardı' cümlesi, basit bir cihazdan (tek lensli) bileşik mikroskoba (iki lensli) geçişi açıklar.
options: A) It had one lens to create an image of the target and another to make it bigger.
B) While it was very useful then, it did not take long for more advanced ones to come.
C) Galilei, himself, did not believe that he could magnify views on lens.
D) This microscope gave the impression that it could pave the way for new previous microscopes.
E) Microscopes have been used in a variety of fields including forensics, metallurgy and medical microbiology.

questions.questionText: 74. Between 4000 and 2000 BC, the first urban civilizations arose independently along the Tigris, the Nile, the Indus and the Yellow River. All of these great rivers are prone to seasonal variations in flow, with flood alternating with dry seasons. ---- To maximize agricultural production, it was necessary to build dams to store the flood waters in reservoirs to water the fields during the dry season. Constructing such schemes required an accurate calendar to predict when the floods would come, and a high degree of social organization.
questions.explanation: Önceki cümlede nehirlerin akışında mevsimsel farklılıklar, kurak mevsimlerle değişen seller olduğu belirtilmiş. Çözüm olarak tarımsal üretimi maksimize etmek için barajlar (build dams to store the flood waters) gerektiğine atıf yapılmalıdır. (Not: Orijinal soruda C seçeneği, 'Tarımsal üretimi maksimize etmek için sel sularını depolamak adına barajlar inşa etmek gerekliydi' şeklindeydi ve bu cümle doğrudan boşluğu dolduran doğru cevaptır).
options: A) Archaeologists have found sites where one Sumerian city was built on top of mud separated by a layer.
B) Although most humans lived in small hunting bands, some pre-farming peoples worked out a very different strategy of survival.
C) To maximize agricultural production, it was necessary to build dams to store the flood waters.
D) They worshipped the gods of the river and believed that floods were punishments.
E) It was here that first people first began to cultivate crops, kick starting a global revolution in the way humans live.

questions.questionText: 75. It was only about a century ago that Jules Verne fantasized about people travelling around the world in only 80 days. Much of what we take for granted today results from technology that has been developed only within the last century. Before then, change occurred slowly. ---- Travellers commonly fly from New York to London in six-and-a-half hours, and communications are almost instantaneous.
questions.explanation: Eskiden değişimin çok yavaş olduğu (Before then, change occurred slowly) belirtiliyor. Sonrasında ise günümüzde New York'tan Londra'ya 6.5 saatte uçulduğundan ve anında iletişimden bahsediliyor. Bu da geçmiş ile bugün arasında bir zıtlık oluşturulmasını gerektirir. E şıkkındaki 'Ancak bugün değişim hızı inanılmaz derecede yüksek' (But today, the pace of change is incredibly rapid) cümlesi köprü görevi görür.
options: A) Demand for new products, services and technology has little impact on international transport.
B) Moreover, the cost of improved communications and transportation has risen more slowly than the speed of travel.
C) The level of the impression that it could make was huge.
D) Since then, it did not take long for more advanced ones to come.
E) But today, the pace of change is incredibly rapid.

questions.questionText: 76. (I) When US athlete Frank Jarvis clocked 11 seconds to win the 100m at the Olympic final in Paris in 1900, it was considered a miracle. (II) Today, such a time would not even qualify an athlete for the English Schools Senior Boys' National Standard of 10.9 seconds. (III) So what has changed? (IV) The most significant factor is the change in body shape in elite athletes - they have longer legs and arms, and it gives them an advantage from the mid-point of the race onwards. (V) However, swimmers have to use four times as much energy as runners to cover the same distance.
questions.explanation: Paragrafta koşucuların (atletlerin) hızlarının yıllar içindeki değişimi ve elit atletlerin vücut şekillerindeki farklılıkların bu gelişime nasıl katkı sağladığı (I, II, III, IV) anlatılmaktadır. V. cümlede ise yüzücüler ve koşucuların enerji tüketimini kıyaslayarak (swimmers have to use four times as much energy) ana odak olan atletlerin koşu performansından tamamen sapılmıştır.
options: A) I
B) II
C) III
D) IV
E) V

questions.questionText: 77. (I) Children, like adults, use three visible cues - race, gender and age to arrange their social world. (II) The next step might be to see whether living in multilingual countries can change this early tendency. (III) They prefer to make friends with kids similar to them based on these traits. (IV) New research, however, shows that language accents may be equally important in guiding youngsters' social decisions. (V) In fact, accents may be even more meaningful than race in signifying whether someone belongs in your social group.
questions.explanation: Paragraf, çocukların sosyal dünyalarını (arkadaşlarını) seçerken kullandıkları görünür ipuçlarını (ırk, cinsiyet, yaş) (I, III) ve yeni araştırmaların gösterdiği üzere dil aksanının da en az bu ipuçları kadar önemli olmasını (IV, V) anlatmaktadır. II. cümlede ise 'çok dilli ülkelerde yaşamanın bu eğilimi değiştirip değiştirmeyeceğini görmek' diyerek araya alakasız bir ileri araştırma hedefi sokulmuştur. 'They' zamiri III. cümlede doğrudan I'e atıfta bulunur.
options: A) I
B) II
C) III
D) IV
E) V

questions.questionText: 78. (I) Material that makes its way from short-term memory to long-term memory enters a storehouse of almost unlimited capacity. (II) Like a new file we save on a hard drive, the information in the long-term memory is filled and coded so that we can retrieve it when we need it. (III) Repeating a word several times, for example, is a popular strategy to keep information in short-term memory. (IV) Evidence of the existence of long-term memory comes from a number of sources. (V) For example, people with certain kinds of brain damage have no lasting recall of new information after the damage, although people and events stored in memory before the injury remain intact.
questions.explanation: Paragraf uzun süreli belleğin işleyişi (sınırsız kapasite, kodlama) ve kanıtlarına (I, II, IV, V) odaklanmıştır. III. cümlede ise kısa süreli bellekte bilgi tutmak için kullanılan kelime tekrarı stratejisinden bahsedilmektedir ki bu uzun süreli bellek konseptinin dışındadır.
options: A) I
B) II
C) III
D) IV
E) V

questions.questionText: 79. (I) The traditional image of the computer gamer is of a teenage boy addicted to sitting in the dark in front of a screen. (II) Actually, an increasing percentage of users and buyers of computer games are women, who are thought to be attracted by the appearance of sophisticated simulation games. (III) It has been argued that unlike film or television, computers permit greater interaction between users. (IV) Furthermore, the majority of computer gamers have an avarage age around 30. (V) Some two-fifths of the most frequent players are over 35.
questions.explanation: Metinde geleneksel bilgisayar oyuncusu imajı (genç erkek çocuğu) çürütülmektedir (I). II. cümlede oyuncuların kadın da olabildiği, IV ve V. cümlelerde de yaş ortalamasının aslında 30'larda olduğu (ergen olmadığı) anlatılarak oyuncu profili analizi yapılır. III. cümlede ise bilgisayarların televizyon ve filme kıyasla daha çok etkileşime izin vermesi anlatılarak oyuncu demografisinden (profilinden) tamamen sapılmıştır.
options: A) I
B) II
C) III
D) IV
E) V

questions.questionText: 80. (I) Sand particles and dust from the roads make up a large proportion of air pollution. (II) The composition of household dust will vary from place to place, but it mostly consists of organic matter that naturally comes off people, pets, plants and anything else that lives in our homes. (III) The main components include human skin flakes, fibres from plants, clothing and furnishings, smoke and oil droplets from cooking. (IV) Our hobbies also add a personal signature to house dust. (V) Woodworkers have wood dust in their homes, cooks make savoury dust, while readers produce papery particles.
questions.explanation: II, III, IV ve V numaralı cümleler kapalı alanlardaki 'ev tozu'nun (household dust) bileşimi ve kişisel/evsel faktörlerle nasıl şekillendiğine dair bir bütünlük sergilemektedir. I. cümlede ise dış ortamdaki (roads, air pollution) kirlilik kaynaklarından olan kum ve tozdan bahsederek metnin ev tozu (household dust) özeliyle uyuşmamaktadır.
options: A) I
B) II
C) III
D) IV
E) V
